newsitem.title: USA: MCI says to expand Iowa calling centers.
newsitem.headline: MCI says to expand Iowa calling centers.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said it plans to add more than 100 jobs at its network conference call centers in Cedar Rapid, Iowa, and Davenport, Iowa.

The average number of daily conference calls handled by the Davenport call center has increased this year by 25 percent. At the Cedar Rapids call center, call volume has increased 42 percent since last year and the facility handles more than 13,000 calls weekly, MCI said.
"We anticipate the volume of conference calls handled by our Cedar Rapids and Davenport facilities to nearly double this year," said networkMCI Conferencing president Phil Knell.
As a result, networkMCI Conferencing said it anticipates hiring about 75 new employees at the Davenport call center by July, in addition to doubling the size of the facility.
The Cedar Rapids call center expects to hire about 40 new employees and increase its floor space by 50 percent by year's end, the company said.
